Sample.evidence_source: In December 2008, 1024 adolescents from four schools of secondary education throughout the Netherlands participated (51% boys). Six months later, in June 2009 we fielded the second wave among 941 adolescents (mean age 14.3, SD = 1.4). In total, 851 respondents (51% male) were matched between waves (i.e., corresponding names or student numbers, see procedure below). Of these respondents, 543 had played video games throughout the two waves and had fully completed both questionnaires. Only these 543 game-playing adolescents were included in our analyses.
